entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: A centaur philosopher and teacher on Theros, leader of the Elpidian school and senior Speaker of The Twelve of Meletis, Chosen of Ephara.

entities.name: Elpidian school
entities.description: Dominant school of philosophers led by Perisophia.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: God who visited Perisophia in dreams.

entities.name: Weeping Woman
entities.description: A Lachrymosa at Asphodel who stole children and turned them into Returned.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: Place haunted by the Weeping Woman.

entities.name: Iris
entities.description: Oracle of Ephara hunted by agents of Purphoros.

entities.name: Alexio
entities.description: Skyguard who escorted Iris and was killed.

entities.name: Soli
entities.description: Garrison Iris was to be taken to.

events.summary: Ephara visits Perisophia in dreams and warns of Xenagos.
events.quote: the god warned her champion of the coming of Xenagos

events.summary: Perisophia judges a phalanx leader who could not kill the children turned Returned, naming him an honored servant.
events.quote: Perisophia instead named him an honored servant of their people for his tenderness

events.summary: The assembly holds a blood ritual to banish the Lachrymosa, with Perisophia taking part.
events.quote: hold a blood ritual in the saltmarsh to banish the Lachrymosa

events.summary: Perisophia has Iris escorted in secret by Alexio; Alexio is killed and Iris escapes on a pegasus.
events.quote: Alexio had been killed and Iris had escaped on a loyal pegasus

relations.quote: She is the leader of the dominant Elpidian school of philosophers
the senior Speaker of The Twelve, the ruling council of Meletis
She is also a Chosen of the god Ephara .
